summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py. It runs a callback (awaiting coroutine results) in the app's event loop from another thread and blocks until it returns the result. It raises RuntimeError if the app isn't running or if called from the app's own thread, to avoid deadlock. The app now records its loop and thread id in _process_messages. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py in the repo's async test style, but it cannot run in the shared venv because no async pytest plugin is installed (existing async tests fail the same way). A standalone script outside the repo verified the behaviour: results were correct, the callback ran on the app thread, and the same-thread guard raised. Nothing was committed.
